representation: Exact original-case/Unicode whole whitespace group; one synthetic editorial marker; identical to marked site span; no normalization. Selected mark ordinal=1; character position retained in full group.
scope: NUREMBERG only; blind eligibility; expansion length does not select held sites. Synthetic editorial marker does not establish native graphical homography.
domain_rule: Per held book, use other three books only. Eligible marked types have at least two exact expansions each with >=5 occurrences on >=3 distinct (book,page_id) physical-source pages. Candidate domain retains ALL train-attested exact expansions for eligible types, including less frequent expansions.

context_provenance.prediction_restriction: Context must use diplomatic_marked as observed; expanded neighboring words are not prediction inputs. writer_id is existing metadata, not inferred syntax. Book/record IDs must not serve as expansion lookup keys.
